items.reason: This is the mattifying gel you asked for, and it gives a shine-free finish as your daily moisturizer.
A gentle, non-stripping cleanser keeps skin clean without adding to a tight, dry-looking feel.
Your scan shows low moisture, so a light hydrating serum under the gel adds comfort without adding shine.
A tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides suits deeper skin tones, blends without a chalky cast, and protects during the day.

response.routine_note: Morning: cleanse, apply the hyaluronic serum, then the mattifying gel, then the tinted SPF. Evening: cleanse, then the serum and gel again, and you can skip the SPF.
